tools.name: search
tools.description: Find WoW Forever records by name in the requested language. Returns kind, slug and exact production page path. Use that path with get_entity. Known level-gated records above beta level 30 are excluded. Localized guides have no record API and are not returned.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Read a page path returned by search or list_entities. Returns the full English API record where available; localized and search-only records return explicitly marked previews. Null remains unknown. Arrays are paged at up to 48 rows; use a pagination field with its nextOffset to continue.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: Browse a kind of WoW Forever record in name order, with exact production page paths. Pass nextOffset as offset to continue. Uses the same locale and beta scope as search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
